symptom: v0.25.0 skill pack contradicted the binary: three examples marked correct failed `mxcli check` (`$response` created twice in an error handler, MDL063/CE0111; a view entity declaring String(400) and unlimited String over `a + ' ' + b`, MDL031), and prose taught `create or replace` as delete-and-recreate with a new UUID, a `Folder:` property for pages (MDL-DEPR105), and `docker check`/`build` as the way to clear CE0463
cause: `scripts/check-skill-mdl.sh` splits blocks into statements and fails only on syntax, so a whole example that parses but that check rejects was never judged. The prose claims were true once and never re-read when `or replace` became an alias (snippet replace now reuses the stored ID via UpdateSnippet) and when docker check moved to a temporary copy
file: `scripts/check-skill-mdl-semantics.sh` (new gate, wired into `make check-skill-mdl` and push-test.yml); skill files under `.claude/skills/mendix/`
insight: The 2026-10-01 mdl 1 pass already ran the real `mxcli check` over every whole block as a ONE-OFF and fixed 18 semantic failures — then nothing kept it true, and three came back. A one-off sweep is a measurement, not a guard: if it found anything, make it a gate the same day. Gate design that keeps it quiet: judge the WHOLE block (statement-splitting loses the variable context MDL063 needs); skip on `MDL-SYNTAX` (a fragment, owned by the syntax gate) and on check's 'produced no statements' (real SQL/OQL in a ```sql fence); ignore MDL-DUPDEF (alternatives shown side by side). Use `check --json` + jq on `ruleId`, not grep on the coloured text. For the prose claims, verify against the executor and `mxcli help`, not the linter alone: `cmd_pages_create_v3.go` shows snippet replace reusing the stored ID, and `help docker check` states the temp copy. docs-site still has ~24 whole blocks failing check (MDL020/021/023, MDL-WIDGET34…), left out of the gate's scope
